PutContactGroup.description_zh: 调用PutContactGroup接口创建或修改报警联系组

PutCustomEvent.description_zh: 调用PutCustomEvent接口上报自定义事件的监控数据

PutCustomEventRule.description_en: Calls the PutCustomEventRule operation to create an alert rule for a custom event

PutCustomMetric.description_zh: 调用PutCustomMetric接口上报自定义监控数据

PutCustomMetricRule.description_zh: 调用PutCustomMetricRule接口创建自定义监控报警规则

PutEventRule.description_en: Creates or modifies an event-based alert rule by calling the PutEventRule operation
PutEventRule.description_zh: 调用PutEventRule接口创建或修改事件的报警规则

PutEventRuleTargets.description_zh: 调用PutEventRuleTargets接口添加或修改规则的推送渠道

PutExporterOutput.description_en: Creates or modifies a monitoring data export configuration by calling the PutExporterOutput operation

PutExporterRule.description_zh: 调用PutExporterRule接口创建或修改数据导出规则

PutHybridMonitorMetricData.description_zh: 调用PutHybridMonitorMetricData接口将指定监控数据上报至企业云监控的指定指标仓库中

PutLogMonitor.description_en: Creates or modifies a log monitoring metric by calling the PutLogMonitor operation

PutMonitoringConfig.description_zh: 调用PutMonitoringConfig接口设置云监控插件的全局配置

PutResourceMetricRules.description_en: Calls the PutResourceMetricRules operation to create multiple threshold alert rules for a specified metric of a specified resource
PutResourceMetricRules.description_zh: 调用PutResourceMetricRules接口为指定资源的指定监控项设置多条阈值报警规则

SendDryRunSystemEvent.description_en: Debugs a system event of an Alibaba Cloud service

UninstallMonitoringAgent.description_en: Uninstalls the CloudMonitor agent from a third-party host
